scope: Offline fixed n-step target construction and raw-400D temporary critic fits on the saved trace only.

target_construction.T_GAE: Stored formal duration-aware SMDP GAE target; source compute_macro_smdp_gae recomputation must match within 1e-5.
target_construction.T_N_STEP: G=sum_{j=0}^{n-1 or until terminal} gamma^(sum actual_duration before j)*R_j + gamma^(sum actual_duration over consumed transitions)*V_old(s_after_n); bootstrap only if n nonterminal transitions are available in the same episode.
target_construction.terminal_rule: If terminal occurs before or at requested n-step endpoint, include rewards through terminal and do not bootstrap. No episode boundary is crossed.
target_construction.T_MC: Stored realized_return_to_go with terminal bootstrap zero; long-horizon diagnostic reference only.

offline_critic_fit.purpose: Temporary fresh in-memory diagnostic v9-style critics fitted to fixed targets on the saved trace only; raw 400D input only.
offline_critic_fit.architecture: 400->128->128->1, SiLU hidden activations, raw input transform 2*x-1

classification.mc_clearly_better_rule: YES only when MC step200 median TEST_EV exceeds both the best fixed n-step and GAE by at least 0.5, with no n-step gate passing.

previous_diagnostic_context.reason: T3 changes the effective return horizon together with removing bootstrap, so this gate uses fixed n-step estimators instead.

final_requested_fields.NEXT_DECISION: Design a separate formal N1 target-replacement experiment; this offline gate leaves the current GAE unchanged.

rules.no_systematic_correlation_degradation: Fewer than 3/4 test folds have correlation delta < -0.15 versus GAE.
rules.std_ratio_closer_to_1: Median absolute distance |pred/target std ratio - 1| is lower than GAE.
rules.mean_bias_not_overly_increased: Median absolute prediction mean bias is no greater than GAE.
